mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_tenant_renew_order (tenant_code, plan_code, months, amount, out_trade_no, channel, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantCode}, #{planCode}, #{months}, #{amount}, #{outTradeNo}, #{channel}, 'unpaid', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, plan_code, months, amount, out_trade_no, channel, status, paid_at, create_time, update_time FROM sys_tenant_renew_order WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_tenant_renew_order SET status = 'paid', paid_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 'unpaid'
